name: Being A Good Wife
overview: Scripture portrays a good wife as a virtuous and prudent woman whose character brings honor and stability to her household. She is described as a crown to her husband and a wise builder of her home, reflecting the favor and blessing of the Lord. The value of such a wife is exalted above rubies, emphasizing her rare and precious nature. Additionally, the call for wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord highlights the importance of a Christ-centered attitude in fulfilling this role.
